title: The writer input gives each text slot the length window W03 applies
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A text slot's characters window has the copy check's floor and ceiling: its edges pass W03, one character outside fails.
A lead and points slot also gets lead and average point windows as W03 judges them.
A short demo the plan does not narrow gets no window; an article lead gets no floor.
The writer's fixed message explains how to read the windows.

tests: a slot is given the window W03 applies: its edges pass and one character outside fails
a lead and points slot is given its lead and average point windows, as W03 judges them
a short demo the plan does not narrow gets no window; an article lead gets no floor
the fixed part says how to read the windows
